summary: Delivered typed on-demand bounded container logs with four fixed modes, a ten-second SSH timeout, 512 KiB UTF-8-safe response truncation, and no persistence into Activity or alerts.

validationCommands.summary: Container detail/log UI typechecks and builds.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Backend enforces request and output bounds
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Closed enum only permits four approved modes; output is hard-capped at 512 KiB.
SSH errors map through the established ApplicationError codes.

notes: Logs are one-shot only and are never persisted.
